name: birkare-ai
description: BirKare AI — güvenli AI fotoğraf stüdyosu monorepo

scripts.dev:mobile:local: node apps/mobile/scripts/mobile-env.mjs --env-file .env -- pnpm exec expo start --dev-client --clear
scripts.eas:ios:dev-simulator: cd apps/mobile && pnpm dlx eas-cli@latest build --platform ios --profile development-simulator
scripts.dev:ios:local: node apps/mobile/scripts/mobile-env.mjs --env-file .env -- pnpm exec expo run:ios
scripts.dev:android:local: node apps/mobile/scripts/mobile-env.mjs --env-file .env -- pnpm exec expo run:android
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
